        x = a + b
    fin = fin[x - 1:]
    # Collect last a characters into a set
    set_chars = set(fin[-a:])

    for i in range(26):
        ch = chr(ord('a') + i)
        if ch in set_chars:
            continue
        fin += ch
        op -= 1
        if op == 0:
            break
    ch = fin[-1]
    # Append ch b times
    fin += ch * b
    # Collect last a characters into a set
    set_chars = set(fin[-a:])

    print(len(set_chars))

if __name__ == "__main__":
